verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents an official CLI that retrieves secrets and items in scripts and CI/CD, and it separately documents TOTP code generation in its apps. No evidence shows the CLI or any API returning a current TOTP code. The CLI's listed item types are passwords, notes, cards, identities, WiFi, custom and SSH keys, with no mention of TOTP output. Combining the two separate claims would credit an adjacent feature, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
